build.summary: I built diag-scenario-registry. There is now a glob registry of named diagnostic scenarios with 7 scenarios. Each case it builds has the deterministic id 'scn|<id>|<seed>', and resolveCase and reconstructCase decode it. When a case has a chart, the patient engine is built from the case id and the chart. A new session module runs each scenario's script and exports the events it can raise. Lessons and the case library open these scenarios in the free lab, and the pre-brief shows the chart plus questions about the problem it plants. The 4 new test files pass (25 tests) and the typecheck is clean. The 'browser' acceptance item was not checked in a browser; a server-render test covers the same path.

build.notes:
The snapshot of the 6 existing listed files and the .started marker are in datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/diag-scenario-registry/. The only file created outside the list is the new test src/ui/sim/modules/script.test.ts.

What was built:
- Registry: src/simulation/diagnosticScenarios/index.ts finds packs by glob. A DiagScenario has id, title, brief, lessonIds, module, spec, lesions, grafts, events, chart, planted, startAt, script, checks, mode and objectives; it also exports the script condition and action types.
- Scenarios (core.ts, with core.launch.ts beside it): diag-ohca-post-rosc, diag-contrast-sensitive, diag-nitrate-pde5, diag-graft-search, diag-scad-suspected, diag-trace-recognition and diag-prior-radiation.
- caseGenerator.ts: scenarioCase(id, seed, lookup?), scenarioCaseId, decodeScenarioCaseId and DEFAULT_SCENARIO_SEED. reconstructCase, and so resolveCase, decode 'scn|…' ids. Existing library and generated cases are unchanged, so no realism re-capture is needed.
- labSession.ts: creatineForEgfr, chartRenal, profileFromChart and engineOptionsForCase. The chart sets sex, age, height, weight, renal function (eGFR as written, Cockcroft-Gault CrCl, Cigarroa), LVEF, contrast allergy, the PDE-5 inhibitor with its timing, and a DOAC or warfarin.
- script.ts: a session module with these conditions: afterS, first injection of a side, tipState, engagement, and contrast at the warning or the ceiling. Actions raise an event (held for the case, for a set time, or the default transient hold), change the engine (rhythm, vasodilation, haemorrhage, occlusion) or put a fault in the line (air, open to air, height). Its raises are derived from the registry.
- prebrief.ts: chartRows, pde5WithinWindow, chartQuestions(chart, planted?) and prebriefWithChart. The five planted problems are pregnancy status not documented, a PDE-5 inhibitor within its window, the eGFR ceiling, a radiation skin injury and the operation note. Each question cites its module source (Brilakis 3.2, 2.6, 1.1, 1.6, 18.1 and 28.3; Oxford ch 1, 2 and 4) through PDE5_WINDOW_H and contrastBudget.
- The eGFR-ceiling question needs a decision: since 3.7 × eGFR is stricter than 5 mL/kg for most patients, the ceiling is asked only when a scenario lists it in planted, or when eGFR is below 30 (the sourced Brilakis 28.3 advisory threshold). That avoids inventing an eGFR cut-off.
- PreBrief.tsx: a ChartPanel (Clinical Graphite tokens) that shows what the chart records with nothing flagged.
- Simulator.tsx: takes 'cathlab' launches (scenario, seed, mode, events) through useLabLaunch whenever there is no hand-over. An exam launch loads as an exam; guided, supervised and independent set the policy and overlays.
- CaseLibrary.tsx: a Scenarios tab grouped by curriculum module, with lesson chips that open the lesson (titles come from the lazily loaded content), plus 'Open in the lab' and 'Another patient' (new seed).

Gaps against the lab requests (all are later packages' work):
- cp-complex-patients#4: no triage decision before the lab and no vasopressor radial-spasm model.
- hb-background#6: no pulmonary oedema event or treatment.
- pm-lab-drugs#1: no dosed nitrate order; the engine's existing PDE-5 interaction applies once a nitrate is given.
- hb-lab-and-radiation#4: no pedal or C-arm discipline detection.
- cp-prior-cabg#0: graft geometry, engagement and graft-not-found belong to diag-grafts-svg.

Other behaviour to know:
- startAt is stored but not acted on: the legacy lab always starts at the root.
- A launch on mount builds the lab session twice (once for the old case, once for the new); this is harmless.
- Every diagnostic session now has the 'scenario-script' module; for cases that are not named scenarios it does nothing.

review.verdict:
Changes needed. Most of the design is built, and the 3 package test files pass (23 tests, not the 25 the builder reported). The typecheck is clean, and the neighbouring tests pass (reachability, sessionModules, caseGenerator, practiceIndex). The 7 failures in content.test.ts and mentor.test.ts were already there before this package. All other src files modified after .started belong to other packages' listed files: haemo-study-session-and-tips (and other haemo packages), proc-tip-context, and the caseSession.ts packages. The clinical numbers and teaching text I checked are sourced from the module text (OHCA triage, graft order, operation note, skin injury, pregnancy, PDE-5 windows, 3.7 × eGFR, Brilakis 28.3).

I ran the browser acceptance item myself against the existing dev server on port 5173. The lesson's Practise row (pm-engaging-trace) does open 'Read the trace before every injection' in guided mode. However, no pre-brief appears, so neither the chart nor the planted pregnancy question is ever shown. That acceptance item fails. The server-render test passes only because it renders PreBrief directly and skips the time-out gate.

The other problems: the engine patient contradicts the chart on some seeds; the scenario title, shown in the live header, gives away a diagnosis; and diag-graft-search clashes with the plan for diag-grafts-svg. These need fixing before the package is accepted.

findings.problem: The PreBrief, and with it the ChartPanel and chartQuestions, renders only while !attending.timeOutDone. useAttending starts with timeOutDone = !policy.visibility.timeOutRequired, and visibility.ts sets timeOutRequired to false for 'guided' and 'independent'. So in guided and independent modes a named scenario's chart and its planted question are never shown. I confirmed this in the browser: the pm-engaging-trace Practise row loaded scn|diag-trace-recognition|1 under 'Guided practice', with no pre-brief, no [aria-label='Patient chart'] and no 'Pregnancy status' text. The same happens for 'Another patient' and 'Open in the lab' whenever the learner's level resolves to guided or independent. The 'browser' acceptance criterion is not met, and the chart, the core of the design, is unreachable in the default lesson launch mode.
findings.fix: In Simulator.tsx (LabScreen), add `const [chartBriefDone, setChartBriefDone] = useState(false)` (it resets on remount, since the key includes the caseId). Render the PreBrief modal when `!finished && (!attending.timeOutDone || (!!caseData.chart && !chartBriefDone))`. Change onComplete to `() => { setChartBriefDone(true); if (!attending.timeOutDone) attending.completeTimeOut(); }`. Add a test that mounts LabScreen in guided mode for diag-trace-recognition (or extracts the gate into a pure helper such as `showPrebrief(timeOutDone, hasChart, briefDone, finished)` and tests it), so the gate itself is covered, not only a direct PreBrief render.

findings.problem:
The chart overrides only sex, age, size, renal function, LVEF, allergies.contrast, PDE-5 and a DOAC or warfarin. Everything else keeps the seeded AngioCAD draw, so the engine patient contradicts the chart. I checked with vite-node on generatePatient('scn|<id>|<seed>'):
(a) Anticoagulation. diag-contrast-sensitive seed 3, diag-nitrate-pde5 seeds 3 and 4, and diag-prior-radiation seed 2 come out in AF on warfarin; diag-scad-suspected seed 2 and diag-graft-search seed 3 are on a DOAC. None of these charts lists an anticoagulant, and when the seeded doac field is absent the DOAC state is inconsistent.
(b) Indication. diag-ohca-post-rosc draws 'SA' at seeds 2 to 5, so engine.preloadAcs (engine.ts:562) returns early and the monitor shows no ischaemia, although the chart and case say persistent ST elevation. The elective diag-contrast-sensitive draws 'STEMI' at seeds 1 to 5, so a culprit is preloaded.
(c) Haemodynamics. lvedp, sbp and hr are computed from the seeded LVEF before the chart's LVEF replaces it; for diag-contrast-sensitive seed 6 that gives EF 30 with lvedp 8.
(d) Other allergies. allergies.other falls back to seeded penicillin, latex or antiseptic allergies that the chart does not record.
This defeats the package's purpose of one patient from one seed. It mostly shows on 'Another patient' seeds, but it also affects the default seed '1' (diag-contrast-sensitive seed 1 is STEMI).
findings.fix: Add `indication?: Indication` to DiagScenario (index.ts) and set it in core.ts: STEMI for diag-ohca-post-rosc, SA for diag-contrast-sensitive, diag-nitrate-pde5, diag-graft-search, diag-trace-recognition and diag-prior-radiation, and NSTEMI or UA for diag-scad-suspected. Pass it through engineOptionsForCase to `generatePatient(seed, { sex, ageY, indication })`; the chart can carry it too if found-case-model-types adds it, but CaseChart is outside this package. In profileFromChart, start from `anticoagulation: 'none', doac: undefined` and `allergies.other: chart.allergies?.other ?? []`, and let only the chart's drugs set anticoagulation. When chart.echo.lvef differs from p.lvef, recompute lvedp with generatePatient's own model line. Better still, export a small `haemodynamicsFor(lvef, indication, ...)` from patient.ts, which needs a plan change because patient.ts is not in this package, or report it in outOfScope. Add a test over seeds 1 to 10 for every scenario: anticoagulation is 'none' unless the chart lists one, the OHCA indication is STEMI, and profile.allergies.other equals the chart's list.

findings.problem: The case name is the scenario title, and Simulator's header renders caseData.name on the live lab screen in every mode, exams included. 'Spasm and a PDE-5 inhibitor' gives away the angiographic diagnosis (spasm rather than fixed disease) and the planted chart problem. 'A healing skin injury from the last procedure' gives away the pre-brief's planted problem. This breaks the rule of no ground truth on live screens outside guided aids.
findings.fix: Give DiagScenario a neutral `caseName` that states the presentation only. Examples: 'Rest angina, medicines on the chart' for diag-nitrate-pde5, and 'Recurrent angina after a recent PCI' for diag-prior-radiation. Use it as AnatomyCase.name in scenarioCase. Keep `title` for the case library and the .launch.ts practice rows, outside the lab. Alternatively, rename the two titles to neutral wording in both core.ts and core.launch.ts. Add a test that no scenario's caseName contains a lesion morphology word (spasm, SCAD, thrombus, CTO) or a ChartProblem keyword.

findings.problem: diag-graft-search is declared here. The lab-build-plan entry for diag-grafts-svg (lessonAndCaseLinks and acceptance at lab-build-plan.json:3184 and 3216) plans to declare it in grafts.ts and grafts.launch.ts. collectDiagScenarios throws on a duplicate id when DIAG_SCENARIOS is created at module load. caseGenerator imports the registry, so if that package follows its plan, the whole app fails to start, not only a test. The builder reported this in outOfScope, but it needs a plan decision before diag-grafts-svg starts.
findings.fix: Update the diag-grafts-svg plan entry so that package extends the existing scenario instead of redeclaring it. Two options: move diag-graft-search into grafts.ts as part of that package and delete it from core.ts and core.launch.ts at the same time; or let grafts.launch.ts add only `links` entries and scripts for diag-graft-search. Record the decision in docs/curriculum/lab-build-plan.json. Optionally, make collectDiagScenarios report the duplicate through the content test rather than throwing at import time in production.

findings.where: src/ui/sim/labSession.ts header comment and design ('sex and height from the chart' for the thorax)
findings.problem: The design asks that the thorax, the coronary genome and the engine come from one seed, with sex and height from the chart. The thorax takes its sex and habitus from its own seeded genome, so a 38-year-old woman of 165 cm (diag-scad-suspected) can be drawn with a male or large habitus. The builder left this out because FluoroView.tsx and sceneBuilder.ts are not in the package.
findings.fix: Record it as a follow-up in the plan: a renderer-baseline package passes caseData.chart's sex and BMI-derived habitus to the thorax genome when present, and re-runs the realism capture for scenario cases only. Do not change the defaults for cases without a chart.

findings.problem: Simulator.tsx is a component module but now also exports caseForLaunch and loadLaunchedCase, which are not components. With @vitejs/plugin-react, mixed exports disable Fast Refresh for this file, so any edit to it forces a full page reload. Separately, the launch's extra events are filtered only by a kebab-case regex, so unknown event names go into case events.
findings.fix: Move caseForLaunch and loadLaunchedCase into src/ui/sim/labSession.ts, which is in this package's list, or into a new .ts file if the plan allows it. Import them into Simulator.tsx and launch.test.ts from there. Filter extra events with `new Set(LAB_EVENTS).has(x)` instead of KEBAB.

findings.problem: The scenario's only trigger raises high-contrast-volume when contrast reaches the 80% warning of the 111 mL ceiling, about 89 mL. So diag-bg-contrast-heart-failure ('count every millilitre … skip a ventriculogram') first appears only after most of the safe volume is used, and after the ventriculogram decision has passed. It meets the acceptance wording but loses most of its teaching value.
findings.fix: Consider an earlier trigger, for example `when: { firstInjection: 'any' }` raising high-contrast-volume with hold 'case'. This is justified by the chart: EF 30% with severe AS and eGFR 30 is the high-risk setting the tip describes. If that is used, rename the trigger, and update script.test.ts to assert the tip after the first injection and its absence before it.

findings.problem: The habitus mapping `1 + (bmi - 26) * 0.022` clamped to 0.85–1.25 is copied from generatePatient instead of shared, so the two can drift. SCRIPT_EVAL_S is labelled as a MODEL PARAMETER in code but has no entry in docs/realism/facts, which the package rules require.
findings.fix: Report a follow-up to export `habitusForBmi(bmi)` from src/simulation/patient/patient.ts and use it in both places; that file is not in this package's list, so put it in outOfScope. Add SCRIPT_EVAL_S, and the habitus reuse, to docs/realism/facts in the package that owns those docs, or ask for the plan to add the facts file to this package.

findings.problem: startAt is stored but nothing reads it; every scenario uses 'root'. The checks are not wired to the debrief, so they are inert data. The builder disclosed both, but the design lists them as part of the scenario.
findings.fix: Either document in index.ts that startAt and checks are reserved for the full-case and debrief packages, and name those packages, or validate them now. scenarios.test.ts already checks startAt values. Add a test that each check's lessonId is one of the scenario's lessonIds or exists in TRACKS, so that broken references are caught.

rejected: Finding 7 (an earlier diag-contrast-sensitive trigger): not applied. Raising 'high-contrast-volume' at the first injection would tell every tip gated on that event that a large volume has been used when it has not. diag-bg-contrast-heart-failure is gated only on that event, and the follow-on contrast package (diag-contrast-ceilings-oedema, scenario diag-contrast-sensitive-lv) owns the running ceiling and the oedema teaching. Bringing the tip forward needs its own event, which means a tips.ts and LAB_EVENTS change outside this package. The trigger stays at the 80% warning, which meets the acceptance wording.
testsRun: Browser check on the running server (localhost:5173): a guided launch of diag-trace-recognition now opens the pre-brief with [aria-label='Patient chart'] and 'Pregnancy status: Not documented' under 'Guided practice'. The lab header reads 'Exertional angina, positive stress test'.
fix.notes:
Six findings were applied in code: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, and the optional part of 4. Finding 7 was rejected. Findings 5 and 8, and the plan-decision part of 4, need files outside this package, so they are listed under out of scope.

APPLIED
1 (critical, chart pre-brief unreachable in guided and independent modes). I added a pure helper, showPrebrief({timeOutDone, hasChart, chartBriefDone, finished}), in src/ui/sim/labSession.ts. LabScreen in src/ui/sim/Simulator.tsx now holds chartBriefDone state, which resets with the case because the key includes the case id. The pre-brief shows while the time-out is outstanding, or while a chart case's brief has not yet been closed. onComplete sets chartBriefDone and calls completeTimeOut only if the time-out is not done. Cases without a chart behave as before. launch.test.ts tests the gate for guided, independent, supervised, exam, finished, and the diag-trace-recognition launch. I also checked it in the browser (see testsRun).

2 (major, engine patient contradicting the chart). DiagScenario has a new field, indication?: Indication, and core.ts sets it: STEMI for OHCA, NSTEMI for SCAD, SA for the other five. engineOptionsForCase looks up the indication from the case's scenarioId and passes it to profileFromChart(seed, chart, indication), which passes it to generatePatient. profileFromChart now starts with anticoagulation 'none' and doac undefined, and only the chart's drugs set them. allergies.other comes from the chart only. Without an anticoagulant the rhythm is sinus. When the chart's LVEF differs from the seeded one, LVEDP, HR, SBP and DBP move along generatePatient's own model lines (chartHaemodynamics). New tests run seeds 1 to 10 for every scenario and check: indication; culprit null for SA and non-null for a thrombotic ACS; no unlisted anticoagulant; sinus rhythm; allergies equal to the chart; LVEDP near the model line. A second test checks that a chart DOAC and allergy reach the engine and that LVEDP rises as LVEF falls.

3 (major, case name giving away the diagnosis). DiagScenario has a new required field, caseName, which states the presentation only. scenarioCase uses it as AnatomyCase.name and as the generateCase nameHint, so the lab header and the pre-brief title use it in every mode, exams included. title stays for the case library and the .launch.ts rows. I also made the spec nameHints in core.ts neutral. A new test checks that no caseName matches morphology or planted-problem words, and that c.name equals caseName. Any future pack must supply caseName.

4 (major, the diag-graft-search duplicate), partly applied. collectDiagScenarios(files, onError?) still throws without a reporter. The registry now passes a reporter: errors go to DIAG_SCENARIO_ERRORS and console.error, the offender is skipped and the first declaration kept, so the app still starts. A test requires DIAG_SCENARIO_ERRORS to be empty and covers skip-and-report.

6 (minor). I moved caseForLaunch and loadLaunchedCase into labSession.ts, so Simulator.tsx now exports components only. Extra launch events are filtered with new Set(LAB_EVENTS). The launch test now includes the kebab-case non-event 'not-an-event' and a duplicate event.

9 (minor). index.ts now documents startAt as reserved for diag-route-wire-led-radial and checks as reserved for a debrief package; no planned package grades checks yet. A new test checks that every scenario lessonId, and every check's lessonId, is in the scenario's lessonIds or in TRACKS.

OUT OF SCOPE (needs plan or other packages)
- Finding 4 plan decision. The diag-grafts-svg entry in docs/curriculum/lab-build-plan.json (around lines 3184 and 3216) must be changed to extend diag-graft-search rather than redeclare it. Either move it into grafts.ts and delete it from core.ts and core.launch.ts in the same change, or have grafts.launch.ts add only links and scripts. A redeclaration no longer crashes the app, but scenarios.test.ts will fail on DIAG_SCENARIO_ERRORS.
- Finding 5. A renderer-baseline follow-up should pass caseData.chart's sex and the BMI-derived habitus to the thorax genome (FluoroView.tsx, sceneBuilder.ts), for scenario cases only, and re-run the realism capture. The labSession header comment now records this gap.
- Finding 8, and the same issue in the finding 2 fix. Export habitusForBmi(bmi), and ideally haemodynamicsFor(lvef, indication, ...), from src/simulation/patient/patient.ts. Then labSession's copies go: the habitus mapping, and the 0.22 LVEDP slope, the EF<35 adjustment of +8 bpm and -10 mmHg, and the 0.58 DBP ratio in chartHaemodynamics. When the seeded LVEDP was clamped at 6 or 32, the shifted value is approximate.
- Finding 8, facts file. Add SCRIPT_EVAL_S (0.25 s, src/ui/sim/modules/script.ts) and the reused habitus mapping as MODEL PARAMETER entries in docs/realism/facts, through the package that owns those docs.

Files changed (all in the package list): src/simulation/diagnosticScenarios/index.ts, core.ts, scenarios.test.ts, launch.test.ts; src/simulation/caseGenerator.ts; src/ui/sim/labSession.ts; src/ui/sim/Simulator.tsx. core.launch.ts is unchanged; titles still match.

The pre-brief appeared over the lab with the scenario's brief, the chart (46-year-old woman, 163 cm, 71 kg; renal function; echo LVEF 60%; aspirin and bisoprolol; no previous contrast reaction; Pregnancy status: Not documented; consent) and a Questions tab. Question 1 is the planted one: pregnancy status not documented, with the correct option 'Confirm and document her pregnancy status, following local policy'. A screenshot confirmed the pre-brief panel renders cleanly in the Clinical Graphite style. Met.

One patient from one seed: for diag-nitrate-pde5, diag-contrast-sensitive and diag-ohca-post-rosc, window.__lab.engine.profile.seed equals the case id. The engine's sex, age, height and weight match the chart (M 62 178 cm 86 kg; F 78 158 cm 60 kg; M 58 176 cm 84 kg), as do LVEF where the chart gives one (60, 30) and eGFR (82, 30, 68). For diag-nitrate-pde5 the profile has pde5 {agent: sildenafil, hoursAgo: 10}.

eGFR 30 scenario (diag-contrast-sensitive): profile.renal is egfr 30, creatinine 152 umol/L, crclMlMin 25, and vitals().contrast.crclMlMin is 25. contrastBudget() gives a stricter Brilakis ceiling of 111 mL with the warning at 88.8 mL, against Oxford's 300 mL.

Script and tips: diag-ohca-post-rosc raises post-arrest and st-elevation (plus chest-pain) from the first frame. __lab.diagnostic.tips() leads with diag-ohca-ecg-sorts and diag-stemi-predict-artery, and the monitor shows ST V5 +1.2, consistent with the chart's anterior ST elevation. For diag-contrast-sensitive I gave 90 mL through engine.contrast() and stepped with __lab.diagnostic.step. The event list moved from [] to ['high-contrast-volume'] and the tips gained diag-bg-contrast-heart-failure, diag-oedema-on-table and diag-contrast-ceiling-two-rules.

Setup events: diag-graft-search raises prior-cabg (case has 3 grafts; tip diag-graft-op-note-first is shown; the operation note and the catheters that worked before are on the chart). diag-scad-suspected raises scad-suspected (tip diag-ocx-scad-setup is shown). diag-prior-radiation's chart shows the previous CTO PCI 35 days ago and healing erythema. diag-nitrate-pde5's planted question 1 is about the nitrate and sildenafil 10 hours ago.

Case library: the Angio case library has a Scenarios tab listing all 7 scenarios under 7 curriculum-module headings, each with its brief, lesson chips titled from the content, 'Open in the lab' and 'Another patient'. 'Another patient' on the trace scenario loaded scn|diag-trace-recognition|<new seed>, guided, with the pre-brief and the same chart patient in the engine (F 46 163 71). The lesson chip 'Nitroglycerin: dose by pressure, route by purpose' opened pathway pm-lab-drugs / pm-lab-drugs-nitrates.
Console: only Vite connect messages and the React DevTools info line; no errors or warnings.
